# `snaidhm.vector`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from snaidhm/src/vector.almd; do not edit. -->

_Vector paths: fill and stroke._

SVG → RGBA, in Almide.

Enough of SVG 1.1 for program-generated art: svg/g/defs, rect, circle,
ellipse, line, polyline, polygon, path (every command incl. arcs),
transforms, fill / stroke / opacity (attributes and `style`), named, hex,
rgb() and hsl() colours, linear and radial gradients. Shapes become
polygons in device space and are rasterised with signed-area coverage
accumulation (as glyphs are, font.almd); strokes are the union of segment
quads and round caps / joins.

```almide
import snaidhm.vector
```

```almide
type Image = { w: Int, h: Int, rgba: Bytes }
```

## Small helpers

### `Rgba`

```almide
type Rgba = col.Color
```

snaidhm.Color: a second {r, g, b, a} record type makes the native leg emit
the wrong struct for literals (almide/almide#3283).
